thread:
maya: Heads up — staging p99 jumped after last checkpoint onboard (v2.13.0). Noticed around the 10:15 deploy window. :eyes:
sam: saw that on dashboards, p99 latency +120ms on corals. Anything in the release notes about tokenizer tweaks?
liam: there was a tiny tokenizer merge that normalized whitespace merging for some non-ascii sequences — PR 4821. Could change average tokenization density.
oana: ci-bot just posted a perf alert for the nightly run: 
ci-bot: [ALERT] perf/regressions — staging-batch-suite p99 increase 18% vs baseline. job: batch_inference_nightly. link: https://ci/redwood/build/12345
maya: logs show kernel selector switching from tiled-attn to naive-attn at sequence length ~512 for many requests. Kernel affinity flip looks correlated with longer tokenized lengths.
henry: kv-cache eviction counts spiking too? I see a lot of evict/insert churn in the allocator logs. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18T10:16:02Z] kvcache: evict key=usr-ctx-12345 size=48k reason=watermark
[2026-03-18T10:16:02Z] batcher: batch_size=8 latency_ms=58
[2026-03-18T10:16:02Z] kvcache: insert key=usr-ctx-12345 hit=false
[2026-03-18T10:16:03Z] kvcache: evict key=usr-ctx-67890 size=64k reason=watermark
```
sam: so tokenizer change increased avg tokens per prompt, pushing sequences into kernel path that uses O(n^2) kernel? That plus kvcache eviction -> repeated recompute of prefixes -> thrash.
liam: exactly. Onboarding notes for v2.13.0 included a config tweak "splice_normalize": true which collapses certain multi-codepoint sequences into fewer tokens. Weird that it increases tokens — must be edge case with grapheme joins.
oana: can we repro locally? I have a small harness to simulate traffic. maya, can you dump a few inputs that hit the regression?
maya: dropping example set in thread: 
```
"input-A": "ユーザー： こんにちは\nアシスタント：\n",
"input-B": "Here's a long prompt with emoji 👍🏽👍🏽 repeated..."
```
henry: repro run on my laptop with v2.12.8 vs v2.13.0 shows avg tokens went from 78 -> 112 for input-A. Kernel selector threshold at 96 in selector-config.
liam: that threshold is heuristically tuned to favor tiled-attn for <=96. So crossing it forces fallback to generic kernel on coral hardware, p99 hit.
sam: quick mitigation: temporarily adjust selector-config threshold up to 128 for corals, or revert splice_normalize in tokenizer. Which is less risky?
maya: selector-config change is lower risk and can be rolled as a hotpatch. But that only masks the underlying tokenizer drift — we should bisect to confirm PR 4821 is the root cause.
oana: I'll run a bisect across the tokenizer PRs: 4800-4830 range. Plan: run the batch_inference_nightly harness with synthetic traffic and measure p99 kernel switch count and kvcache evictions. Each job is ~20m.
liam: also add profiler flags to capture kernel selection logs: `--trace-kernels=1 --kv-evict-log=1` so we have concrete evidence.
henry: logging note: the kvcache watermark math uses estimated token sizes; if tokenizer changed token sizes distribution, our eviction watermark may be mis-calibrated. That explains spillover despite same memory load.
sam: CI failure blocks the shadow rollout for this model — request to pause staging rollouts until we have a fix. @deploy-bot can you stop the shadow rollout for v2.13.0?
deploy-bot: Action queued — pausing shadow-rollout for model v2.13.0. Reason: perf regression alert.
maya: bisect started: running job id bisect-251726 on infra pool coral-x. I'll post results when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
(20m later)
maya: bisect result: PR 4821 is the likely culprit — repro with tokenizer at that commit reproduces kernel selector flip and 2x eviction churn.
liam: good. Do we have a minimal repro for the tokenizer bug? If yes we can PR a targeted fix rather than revert whole PR.
aona_typo: (typo correction) oana: I've isolated the transform in PR 4821 that mishandles zero-width joiners in emoji sequences. It sometimes splits joiners into extra tokens instead of collapsing — so certain emoji runs expand tokens.
henry: fix idea: revert the specific normalization rule or add a post-normalize pass that preserves grapheme cluster boundaries for emoji/ZWJ sequences.
sam: can we push a hotfix branch with the patch + selector-config tweak to be safe? Dual change: fix tokenizer bug + bump selector threshold as temporary guard.
maya: will prepare PR 4850 with both changes. I'll also add an automated fuzz test for emoji sequences to CI to catch regressions.
liam: after PR 4850 lands, let's run the nightly perf job and monitor kvcache evict rate and kernel switch count. If green, we can resume the rollout.
ci-bot: [INFO] perf/regressions — bisect complete. suspected culprit: PR 4821. next steps: patch PR 4850 created. link: https://ci/redwood/patch/4850
sam: thanks — excellent triage. Please also add a blurb to the release notes and an alert rule for sudden tokenizer-length distribution shifts (delta > 15% triggers).
oana: added task to perf-playbook: "on tokenizer change, validate token length distributions and kernel selector thresholds".
maya: resuming monitoring. Reopen if p99 climbs after patch. :thumbsup:
